slowest_12.cmd:
set -euo pipefail
echo HOST=$(hostname)
echo START_FREQDUET_PREFLIGHT
PY=/home/zhengliang01/scheduleurm_work/conda_envs/freqduet-cpu-py310/bin/python
test -x "$PY"
test -f configs_freqduet/F_freqduet_terminal_main_valueguard_hiro.yaml
test -f configs_freqduet/F_freqduet_gen_highnoise_main_valueguard_hiro.yaml
grep -q "value_guard" runner_v3.py
grep -q "fleet_noharm_lower_value_guard_headway_mean" runner_v3.py
"$PY" -m py_compile runner_v3.py scripts/run_freqduet_ablation.py scripts/compare_freqduet_candidate.py
echo DONE
python -u -c "import sys, numpy, pandas, torch, yaml; import runner_v3; print('deps ok', sys.executable, numpy.__version__, pandas.__version__, torch.__version__)"

set -u; echo PROBE_START=$(date -Is); echo HOSTNAME=$(hostname); echo UNAME=$(uname -a); echo PWD=$PWD; echo USER=$(whoami); echo SLURM_JOB_ID=${SLURM_JOB_ID:-}; echo SLURM_JOB_NODELIST=${SLURM_JOB_NODELIST:-}; echo SLURM_JOB_PARTITION=${SLURM_JOB_PARTITION:-}; echo SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK=${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-}; echo PYTHON3=$(command -v python3 || true); python3 -V 2>&1 || true; echo DF_PWD; df -T "$PWD" 2>&1 || true; echo IMPORT_CHECK; python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, os, sys
mods=['numpy','pandas','yaml','torch','traci','sumolib']
print('sys_executable=' + sys.executable)
print('sys_prefix=' + sys.prefix)
print('base_prefix=' + getattr(sys, 'base_prefix', ''))
print('conda_prefix=' + str(os.environ.get('CONDA_PREFIX','')))
for m in mods:
    spec=importlib.util.find_spec(m)
    print(f'import:{m}:', 'OK' if spec else 'MISSING')
PY
if command -v sumo >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo SUMO_BIN=$(command -v sumo); sumo --version 2>&1 | head -n 2; else echo SUMO_BIN=MISSING; fi; echo PROBE_END=$(date -Is)

set -e
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 TORCH_NUM_THREADS=1 FREQDUET_TORCH_THREADS=1
PY=/home/zhengliang01/scheduleurm_work/conda_envs/freqduet-cpu-py310/bin/python
echo START_TERMFB30_PREFLIGHT $(hostname) $(date)
$PY -m py_compile runner_v3.py upper/timetable_planner.py scripts/run_freqduet_ablation.py scripts/compare_freqduet_candidate.py
$PY - <<'PY'
from runner_v3 import load_config
cfg=load_config('configs_freqduet/F_freqduet_terminal_main_termfb30_hiro.yaml')
print(cfg['_name'], cfg['upper']['timetable_planner']['terminal_feedback'])
PY
echo DONE_TERMFB30_PREFLIGHT $(date)
python -u -c "import sys, numpy, pandas, torch, yaml; import runner_v3; print('deps ok', sys.executable, numpy.__version__, pandas.__version__, torch.__version__)"
